references.text: Here is described Israel's victory over the Amorites under King Sihon and King Og, which is what Balak saw and feared.
Israel's victory over the Canaanites at Hormah, part of what Balak had heard about.
Moses recounts the victory over Sihon, king of the Amorites.
Moses recounts the victory over Og, king of Bashan.
Joshua reminds the people how Balak, son of Zippor, fought against Israel.
Jephthah mentions Balak and asks if he ever fought against Israel.
Micah reminds Israel what Balak, king of Moab, planned.
